title: SC issues notice to Centre, CJP on plea for guidelines to govern protests
description:
The Supreme Court on Thursday agreed to examine a plea by a lawyers' body seeking directions for formulation of uniform guidelines and a standard operating procedure governing public demonstrations and protests.
A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana issued notice to the Centre, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and others.
Senior advocate Mahesh Jethmalani appeared for the lawyers' body.
The top court was hearing a plea by Lawyers Voice seeking directions for framing comprehensive, uniform and effective guidelines defining the responsibilities of organisers and participants at public protests.
The petition argued that while dissent is part of democracy, protests must stay within legal bounds and avoid paralysing the capital or disrupting lawyers' livelihoods.
